card.name: Handling and preparation instructions wording
card.fires_on: Mixed words inside device and administration instructions, such as 'your' before healthcare provider or past experience, 'the' before container or bag, and partway through product names like DAURISMO or prefilled.

modes.label: Your / the in instructions
modes.description: Small words like 'your' or 'the' in directions about discarding, injecting or activating a bag or container.
modes.example: Throw away the fluid and used exchange set as instructed by<< your>> healthcare provider.

modes.label: Inside product or device words
modes.description: Partway through a drug name or device term such as a prefilled syringe or an additive port.
modes.example: There is no specific antidote for DAURIS<<MO>>.
